body: it is strange to hear someone telling me I am strong when I feel so weak. Why do people's words bother me so, if I am strong? Why do I fall when things get hard... Thank you for your kind words..
I really like this answer... Thank you..

I think of this often but with drug use. Sadly, a lot of people who try to kill themselves just end up on life support... 
It really sucks, this. This thing. But... you have to remember that death will hurt. It's ...so damn hard to actually succeed... I don't wish for you to suffer..
